taskSummary: Implement a local file/memory-backed orchestration API for the Codex/MCP plugin and Observatory, with shared run packets and no production payments or auth.
acceptanceCriteria: MCP entitlement decisions come from the backend and expose allowed or subscription_inactive.
HTTP run, account, customer stats, business stats, and SSE endpoints exist.
Run packets persist task-local state without reviewer write access.
Existing tests and smoke checks remain passing.
The implementation is portable to macOS Monterey with an appropriate Node version.

testResults.summary: 69 tests passed; MCP smoke passed; dashboard account, stats, run, entitlement-denial, and SSE paths passed.

privacyBoundary.summary: The local prototype stores only a bounded prompt summary and task-local metadata; no payments, OAuth, API keys, source uploads, raw transcripts, or automatic interception.

knownRisks: Reviewer execution is still an explicit Codex-session adapter gap; runs report complete-with-gap.
Activation and deactivation are intentionally unauthenticated demo controls on loopback only.
The local prototype uses the demo-active account and is not multi-tenant.
Cross-process run-store coordination and interrupted-run recovery are deferred to the hosted backend phase.
Mac Monterey setup must use Node 22; Windows validation does not prove the physical Mac environment.

deterministicGateResults.evidence: Ten planned reviewers, required routes, packet fields, and the requested local prototype boundaries are represented in the implementation and tests.
pnpm test passed 69 tests and pnpm smoke passed active, visual, and inactive entitlement checks.
Source inspection and runtime checks found loopback binding, bounded request input, no source-file payload field, and no external service writes.

reviewerFindings.evidence: Confirmed test subprocess timeout, SSE disconnect isolation, and explicit loopback binding; repairs applied for all three.
Confirmed MCP fail-closed entitlement behavior; recorded demo-only unauthenticated activation and dashboard boundary as known local risks.
Confirmed single-process persistence ordering, cross-process coordination limits, interrupted-run recovery gap, and terminal event ordering; terminal event persistence was tightened.
Confirmed packet requirements and local atomic replacement; unique temp paths and persisted-record validation were added.
Confirmed entitlement fail-closed behavior, declared wave ordering, packet fields, and identified interrupted-run and terminal-event risks.
Confirmed bounded prompt validation and static path containment; safe run IDs and byte-based request limits were added.
Confirmed 69 tests and smoke coverage; identified missing runtime dashboard coverage and Monterey proof, both recorded as follow-up validation risks.
Confirmed MCP/HTTP separation and local-only scope; recorded demo-account coupling and fixture business metrics as future storage seams.
Mapped the existing Node MCP server, Observatory, entitlement file, tests, and local storage boundary; confirmed no payments, OAuth, uploads, or keys.

Arbiter accepted the local prototype for handoff; remaining findings are incomplete automated dashboard integration coverage and deferred interrupted-run recovery. Production auth, payments, hosted storage, and Monterey-on-device proof remain explicitly out of scope.
